title: ranunculus fascicularis var. cuneiformis
intro: Ranunculus fascicularis var. cuneiformis, commonly known as the western buttercup, is a flowering plant species in the Ranunculaceae family. It has been found to possess potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and discomfort, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus fascicularis var. cuneiformis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
